title: feat(pm): line ratchet — a raise is authorized by the ordering ruling of record (id + measured delta in the PR body)
body:
Fixes #23606
Clause-②: no

## Summary

Restates the per-file line ratchet's raise authorization to the ruled form (ruling record 6184799323, letter B, the maintainer's 「同意」 2026-10-15): a ruling of record that ORDERS text into a ratcheted file is the authorization to raise that file's ceiling by the measured lines the text needs. The raising PR quotes that ruling comment's id and the measured line delta in its body and moves the `CEILINGS` row in the same PR by at most that delta — no second word from the maintainer. A raise quoting no ruling id stays red; no tolerance band; 「新增以删减付账」 for every line no ruling ordered; landed ceilings are not revisited.

Quoted from the ruling of record on the card (comment 6184799323):

> 1. A ruling of record that orders text into a ratcheted file is the authorization to raise that file's ceiling by the measured lines the text needs: the raising PR quotes the ruling comment's id and the measured line delta in its body, and moves the `CEILINGS` row in the same PR by at most that delta. No second word from the maintainer is needed.
> 2. A raise with no ruling id stays red. ⛔ No tolerance band (#23177 ruling B item A2′ stands); 「新增以删减付账」 stays for every line no ruling ordered.
> 3. The ratchet's header and refusal text name the form (ruling id + delta in the PR body). The script cannot read rulings; the seat record and the queue guard's reader check the quote.
> 4. The `SKILL.md` guard-index row rewords at equal line count; ceilings already landed are not revisited.

## What changed

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` — ⛔ no `CEILINGS` row moves in this PR; ⛔ no new mechanical check (item 3: the script cannot read rulings).

- Header 「ratchet discipline」 bullet: RAISING restated to the ruled form, citing ruling record 6184799323 as provenance (the file already cites rulings this way). Lowering, the small headroom and the cross-file move are unchanged.
- `verdict()`'s red remedy sentence and the three cross-file-move refusals (two in `crossFileMoveVerdict`, one in `crossFileMoveTotalVerdict`) now name the form: 「the ruling of record that orders the text: its comment id and the measured line delta quoted in the raising PR's body, the `CEILINGS` row moved in the same PR by at most that delta」; `verdict()` adds 「A raise quoting no ruling id stays red, and there is no tolerance band.」 None of the four uses an offer verb of `check:ratchet-remedy-authority`'s grammar, so that gate's `excluded` reading of this file holds (measured below).
- Self-test: the one pin on the old wording (`...and sends the author to the ordinary path rather than to a bigger declaration`) re-pinned to the new form; seven cases added — the form, the delta bound and the no-ruling-id/no-band sentence in `verdict()`; the form in each of the three move refusals; and a negative pin that none of the four line-ceiling refusals still says 「maintainer ruling quoted」. Roster floor 157 → 164 (the roster's own size; every per-battery floor stays). No case weakened or deleted. 164 cases pass (157 on `main`).

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` — 〈机械守卫索引〉 row for the ratchet: the clause 「抬上限需维护者裁决引用在 PR 正文」 reworded to 「抬上限凭下令写入的裁决记录:其评论 id 与实测行数增量引在 PR 正文,同 PR 移上限行至多增量;无裁决 id 即红」; the rest of the row stays. Equal line count (319/319, headroom 0); the row grows 240 → 336 bytes under the file's 342-byte table-row pin (the file's widest row is a different one at 342, unchanged). No issue number in the row (`check:pm-skill-id-lint` clean).

## Evidence

Red-then-green without an ablation: with the four strings changed and the pins untouched, the self-test went red on exactly the old pin (1 failure: `...and sends the author to the ordinary path rather than to a bigger declaration`); with the pins updated it is green at 164 cases.

PM mechanism assumptions, measured:

- (a) The line numbers held at `1ced0f82b` (header bullet 66–70, remedy 2111–2114, refusals 2205/2236/2273, pin 3172; `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` for SKILL.md 342; the row 240 bytes; SKILL.md 319/319).
- (b) `origin/main` moved during the work: PR #23660 landed as `881eeff31` (the `execution-duties.md` row 183 → 185 plus its comment block). Merged into this branch as `1bcccbaf9` — a clean textual merge, disjoint hunks; the branch's delta vs `origin/main` is still exactly the two files above (`git diff origin/main HEAD --stat`: SKILL.md 2 lines, the ratchet 51 lines). That incoming comment block already quotes ruling record 6184799323 as the raise's authorization — the form this PR writes into the header.
- (c) As stated; the four-axis block is untouched (`check:skill-frame-sync` green).
- (d) `git grep -n "maintainer ruling quoted" -- scripts packages .claude` on the branch: inside the file, the remaining hits are the `RULING_CITATION` docblock (defers to the header), the table-row-bytes pin's docblock and refusal (the byte pin — a different ratchet, see Acceptance notes), and the two new negative self-test pins; outside the file only unrelated prose (`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs:338`, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs:1161`, `packages/metadata-core/CHANGELOG.md:614`). Nothing outside the file pins the ratchet's remedy strings — assumption (d) holds.

## Verification (local subset, at `1bcccbaf9`)

Each exit code captured before any pipe (`cmd > log 2>&1; EXIT=$?`). `--ran` reconciliation: exit 0, 「dispatch-gates --ran: 39 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 39 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).」.

- The edited script's own suite: `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, 「✓ check-skill-line-ratchet self-test: 164 cases pass.」; the plain run → exit 0 (SKILL.md 319 lines, ceiling 319, headroom 0; widest table row 342, pin 342; `execution-duties.md` 185/185 after the merge).
- 38 quick families → exit 0 each, among them `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint` (87 files clean), `check:ratchet-remedy-authority` (275 scripts swept; this file still classifies `excluded`), `check:doc-authoring`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:nul-bytes`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`: the first run at `e8ae56f27` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET — `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt; not a measurement); after `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`) it exits 0.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (nohup, exit captured to a file): exit 0, 「✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 1884 cases pass; 6 slow section(s) deferred.」 (269.6 s on this shared box).

CI runs the full farm; the PR's check-runs are cited in the report comment on the card.

## Acceptance notes (observed, not filed)

- The same file's `RULING_CITATION` docblock (「the header's escape hatch (a maintainer ruling quoted in the raising PR)」) and the header section 「A move's raise and an ORDINARY ruled raise are separate quantities」 (「the header's own exit, a ruling quoted in the raising PR」) still describe the ordinary raise in the older, less specific words. Both defer to the header bullet this PR restates and are not false under the ruled form (the ordering ruling IS a maintainer ruling quoted in the raising PR). Left untouched: outside the claimed file surface (header bullet, red remedy, refusals, self-test). carrier: the seat's contract review of this PR (a one-line touch if wanted) · noted, not filed.
- `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` — the per-file widest-table-row pin — keeps 「raising a pin requires a maintainer ruling quoted in the PR」 in its docblock and its refusal. It is a byte pin, not a line ceiling; ruling 6184799323 speaks of measured lines and the `CEILINGS` row. Whether the ruled form extends to the byte pin is a question for the seat, not a finding. carrier: none · noted, not filed.
- `scripts/check-ratchet-remedy-authority.mjs`'s CONTROL entry for this file (`expect: 'excluded'`, 「its ceiling-raise remedy already names the authority it requires」) still reads true: the authority is now the ordering ruling of record, and the gate's verdict for the file did not move (exit 0; 256 scripts excluded, 14 marked, 5 refused, as before).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么

把行数门禁「抬上限」的规则改成你 10-15 裁的 B:一条裁决既然明确要求往受管文件写某段内容,这条裁决本身就是抬上限的授权——PR 正文引这条裁决的评论 id 与实测增加的行数,同一个 PR 把 `CEILINGS` 那一行最多移这么多,不再找你要第二句原话。没有裁决 id 的增长照旧红;不加容差带;没裁决的每一行照旧「新增以删减付账」;已落地的上限不回改。改的是门禁脚本的头注、四处拒绝文案与自测钉子,以及 pm-dispatch SKILL.md 守卫索引那一行(行数不变 319/319)。本 PR 不动任何上限行,不加新门禁。

### 为什么改

30 天抬了 12 次上限,次次都是已裁内容,每次都要你再答一句。裁决 B 去掉的只是这一次「二次报批」;门禁对没有裁决的增长照样响亮拒绝。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)

- 风险:脚本读不到裁决,引文是否属实靠席位的契约复审记录与入队守卫的读者核对(裁决第 3 条);本 PR 不新增机械核验,这是裁决要求的形态,不是遗漏。
- 代价:零发布面(`.claude/**`、`scripts/pm/**`),无 changeset,`skip-changeset`。
- 回滚:revert 本 PR 即回到「每次抬上限需单独一句原话」;已按本规则落地的上限行(如 #23660 的 `execution-duties.md` 183 → 185)不受影响。

### 席位意见

(留空)

### 你要做的

无需你再出声:Tier S,席位按契约复审 PASS 落地。若你想顺手把同文件另外两处旧措辞(见 Acceptance notes 第一条)也改到同一形态,点一句即可。
